"""Database service interfaces for decoupling database implementations from business logic."""

import abc
from typing import Optional, Dict, List, Any, AsyncIterator
from pyrogram.types import Message


class MediaRepository(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for media file operations."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def save_file(self, media) -> tuple:
        """Save a media file and return (success: bool, status_code: int)."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_file_details(self, file_id: str) -> Optional[List[Dict]]:
        """Get file details by file_id."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_search_results(
        self, query: str, file_type: Optional[str] = None, max_results: int = 10, offset: int = 0, filter: bool = False
    ) -> tuple:
        """Get search results as (files: list, next_offset: int, total_results: int)."""
        pass


class UserRepository(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for user operations."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def add_user(self, id: int, name: str) -> None:
        """Add a new user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def is_user_exist(self, id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if user exists."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def total_users_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total user count."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def ban_user(self, user_id: int, ban_reason: str = "No Reason") -> None:
        """Ban a user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def remove_ban(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Remove ban from a user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_ban_status(self, id: int) -> Dict:
        """Get ban status of a user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_all_users(self) -> AsyncIterator[Dict]:
        """Get all users as an async iterator."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def delete_user(self, user_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete a user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_banned(self) -> tuple:
        """Return (banned_user_ids: list, banned_chat_ids: list)."""
        pass


class GroupRepository(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for group/chat operations."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def add_chat(self, chat_id: int, title: str) -> None:
        """Add a new chat."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> Optional[Dict]:
        """Get chat settings."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def update_settings(self, chat_id: int, settings: Dict) -> None:
        """Update chat settings."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_settings(self, chat_id: int) -> Dict:
        """Get chat settings."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def disable_chat(self, chat_id: int, reason: str = "No Reason") -> None:
        """Disable a chat."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def re_enable_chat(self, chat_id: int) -> None:
        """Re-enable a chat."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def total_chat_count(self) -> int:
        """Return total chat count."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_all_chats(self) -> AsyncIterator[Dict]:
        """Get all chats as an async iterator."""
        pass


class ConnectionRepository(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for connection operations."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def add_connection(self, group_id: int, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Add a group connection for a user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def active_connection(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[int]:
        """Get currently active group for user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def all_connections(self, user_id: int) -> Optional[List[int]]:
        """Get all connected groups for user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def if_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Check if group is active for user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def make_active(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Set active group for user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def make_inactive(self, user_id: int) -> bool:
        """Clear active group for user."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def delete_connection(self, user_id: int, group_id: int) -> bool:
        """Delete a group connection for user."""
        pass


class FilterRepository(abc.ABC):
    """Interface for filter operations per group."""

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def add_filter(self, grp_id: int, text: str, reply_text: str, btn: str, file: str, alert: str) -> None:
        """Add a filter to group."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def find_filter(self, group_id: int, name: str) -> tuple:
        """Find a filter by name. Returns (reply_text, btn, alert, fileid)."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def get_filters(self, group_id: int) -> List[str]:
        """Get all filter names in group."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def delete_filter(self, group_id: int, text: str) -> None:
        """Delete a filter by text in group."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def count_filters(self, group_id: int) -> int:
        """Count filters in group."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def del_all(self, group_id: int) -> None:
        """Delete all filters in group."""
        pass

    @abc.abstractmethod
    async def filter_stats(self) -> tuple:
        """Get global stats (totalcollections: int, totalcount: int)."""
        pass
